title: Description is missing or of poor quality
cardHint: The description is empty, too short, the same as the name, or a placeholder. The owner writes what the CI is and what it is for.
cardText: The description is empty, too short, the same as the name, or a placeholder. The owner writes what the CI is and what it is for. On a Business Service or a Service Instance the owner corrects it in EPO. A Business Application is not asked: SACM copies the description of its Service Instance (card Application ≠ Instance).

message.subject: No useful description
message.intro: The description is empty, or does not say what the CI is.
message.ask: Could you reply with one or two sentences per CI: what it is, and what it is used for? We will update ServiceNow for you. You can also raise the request {form:modify-service-offering}.
message.why: The service desk and change approvers read it to understand the CI.

askByClass.service_offering: Could you reply with one or two sentences per offering: what it is, and what it is used for? We will update ServiceNow for you. You can also raise the request {request:modify-service-offering}.

askByTeam.process-management: Could you reply with one or two sentences per process: what the process is and what it does? We will update ServiceNow.
